# CrossCode

> Control your PC's OpenCode — the terminal AI coding agent — from your phone, from anywhere in the world. Free, open source (MIT), and private: your code never touches CrossCode's servers, because there are none.

CrossCode is a monorepo containing a mobile app (React Native + Expo), a Next.js website/dashboard, a companion CLI (`npx crosscode`), shared types/constants, and a self-hosted WebSocket relay server for paid-tier tunnels. Run `npx crosscode` on your PC to start `opencode serve`, open a tunnel, and scan a QR code with the mobile app to connect instantly — no account or configuration required on the free tier.

## Architecture

The monorepo uses pnpm workspaces + Turborepo:

- `apps/mobile`: React Native + Expo mobile app (Expo Router, Zustand, NativeWind)
- `apps/web`: Next.js website and dashboard (PostgreSQL + Drizzle, Sanity CMS, Dodo Payments)
- `packages/crosscode`: Companion CLI published to npm as `crosscode`
- `packages/shared`: Shared types, constants, QR payload schema, plans
- `packages/tunnel-server`: WebSocket relay service for paid-tier tunnels

Connection flow: Mobile App → HTTPS/SSE via tunnel (Cloudflare / ngrok / CrossCode Tunnel relay) → local proxy → `opencode serve` on your PC.

## Tunnel Server

Self-hosted WebSocket relay for paid users, replacing Cloudflare tunnels with dedicated low-latency connections:

- [Tunnel Server Overview](https://github.com/snhsish/crosscode/blob/main/docs/tunnel-server/README.md): Features, project ID derivation, access control, and security model
- [Tunnel Server Architecture](https://github.com/snhsish/crosscode/blob/main/docs/tunnel-server/ARCHITECTURE.md): Protocol design, security model, and data flow
- [Tunnel Server Deployment](https://github.com/snhsish/crosscode/blob/main/docs/tunnel-server/DEPLOYMENT.md): VPS setup, Caddy config, DNS, TLS, and deployment
- [Tunnel Server Development](https://github.com/snhsish/crosscode/blob/main/docs/tunnel-server/DEVELOPMENT.md): Local development, testing, and debugging

## Key Concepts

- **Zero-knowledge relaying**: Servers only relay traffic; code never leaves your machines.
- **QR Connect**: The CLI renders a QR code encoding the connection payload; scanning it connects the app instantly.
- **Tool Call Approvals**: Approve or reject every shell command, file write, or API call before it runs on your PC.
- **Project IDs**: Stable 8-char hex IDs derived from the git remote URL, giving each repo a persistent tunnel URL.
- **Tier fallback**: Paid users get the dedicated CrossCode Tunnel automatically, falling back to Cloudflare; free users default to Cloudflare or ngrok.
